subject: microbiology
title: Proteus Swarming, Urease, Weil-Felix and Enterobacter

steps.tx: **Proteus swarming** turns a colony into concentric waves over blood agar: vegetative cells elongate into hyperflagellated swarmers migrating outward, consolidate, and repeat, obscuring other organisms, prevented on MacConkey (bile) and increased agar or CLED media in urine laboratories. Mirabilis and vulgaris are the two clinical species.
steps.say: Concentric waves swallowing the plate: Proteus announcing itself before any test.

vis.alt: Proteus swarming motility over agar plate
vis.caption: Proteus swarming motility, concentric waves of hyperflagellated cells over agar.

steps.tx: **Urease** is Proteus's urinary weapon: urea split to ammonia alkalinising urine (pH above 7.2), struvite (magnesium ammonium phosphate) and carbonate apatite stones grow around infection, staghorn calculi shelter bacteria, obstruction and sepsis follow, urine smells ammoniacal on the ward before the plate returns.
steps.say: Alkaline urine plus staghorn stone equals urease organism until excluded.

left.title: Stone sequence
points: Struvite precipitates with magnesium and phosphate

right.title: Stone answers
points: Acetohydroxamic acid urease inhibitor historical niche

steps.tx: **Weil Felix** returns here as Proteus's serological second career: OX2, OX19 and OXK strains (mirabilis and vulgaris variants) agglutinate rickettsial antibodies (serology module), a cross reaction of Proteus O antigens with Rickettsia, so a urinary Proteus can false positive the fever panel historically.
steps.say: Proteus lends its O antigens to rickettsial diagnosis and occasionally lies there.

left.title: Strain map
points: Non flagellated O variants selected for test

steps.tx: **Proteus bench identity** beyond swarming: gram negative motile rods, phenylalanine deaminase positive (genus signature with Providencia and Morganella kin), urease rapid, H2S positive, lactose non fermenter, indole divides mirabilis (negative) from vulgaris (positive). The tribe now splits into Proteus, Morganella and Providencia genera.
steps.say: Deaminase plus urease plus swarm: Proteus tribe in three tests.

right.title: Resistance notes
points: Intrinsic colistin and tigecycline resistance tribe wide

steps.tx: **Enterobacter** (cloacae complex and aerogenes now Klebsiella aerogenes) is the motile VP positive AmpC carrier of hospital water and sink outbreaks, intrinsically cephalosporin threatening on therapy (genetics module), plant associated sakazakii (Cronobacter) in powdered infant formula meningitis its notorious cousin.
steps.say: Enterobacter carries inducible AmpC and hospital water habits; Cronobacter haunts formula tins.

left.title: Enterobacter profile
points: Sinks, ventilators and IV fluid outbreaks

steps.tx: **Dienes phenomenon** (two Proteus strains swarming toward each other stop at a demarcation line if different, merge if identical) typed strains before molecules, still demonstrated in teaching laboratories. Swarming is thus both nuisance and fingerprint.
steps.say: Swarm lines that merge mean identical strains; a line between means different.

right.title: Swarm control media
points: CLED for urine (electrolyte deficient stops swarm)
Phenylethyl alcohol agar gram negative selective kin

steps.tx: **Catheter urinary Proteus** encrusts catheters with crystalline biofilm (struvite in the lumen) blocking flow faster than other organisms, long term catheter patients cycling obstruction and sepsis, management by catheter change, hydration traditions and stone surveillance rather than chronic suppression alone.
steps.say: Blocked catheter with gritty encrustation is Proteus writing in stone.

right.title: Management
points: Change catheter and culture from new
Imaging for bladder and kidney stones

steps.tx: **Morganella and Providencia** complete the tribe clinically: Morganella morganii (histidine decarboxylase, scombroid kin, AmpC), Providencia stuartii (catheter urine in care homes, multidrug), rettgeri, each intrinsically colistin resistant like Proteus, speciation by panels and MALDI in urine heavy laboratories.
steps.say: Care home catheter urine growing Providencia stuartii is a resistance consultation waiting.

right.title: Providencia
points: Stuartii: long term catheter, care facilities
Intrinsic colistin and tigecycline resistance shared
